subject: Weekend hobbies and priorities
text:
Hi,

Sorry if this jumps around a bit. I was cleaning my desk and found that old class notebook where we talked about weekends and hobbies. Since taking on new work, my priorities shifted, so I stopped painting and started evening walks. I still think you would enjoy the nearby river route for a while when you need a real break from screens. I hope the first week of client work is going well enough. Maybe we can swap hobby updates once calendars loosen up.
